slides.h:
Evolution · 1/10

Four steps of natural selection自然选择的四步

1 Variation: individuals differ. 2 Inheritance: some traits are passed on. 3 More offspring are born than can survive. 4 Individuals with helpful traits survive and breed more.1 变异：个体各不相同。2 遗传：有些性状会传下去。3 出生的后代多于能存活的。4 有利性状的个体存活并繁殖得更多。

Evolution · 2/10

Peppered moth example桦尺蛾的例子

Soot darkened the trees. Dark moths were hidden from birds, light moths were eaten. Dark moths bred more, so dark became the common colour.烟灰把树干熏黑了。深色蛾不易被鸟发现，浅色蛾被吃掉。深色蛾繁殖更多，深色因此变得常见。

Evolution · 3/10

Individuals do not evolve个体不演化

Individuals do not change their genes to fit the environment. The population changes, because some alleles become more common across generations.个体不会为适应环境而改变基因；是种群在改变，因为某些等位基因在世代间变得更常见。

Evolution · 4/10

Microevolution and macroevolution微观与宏观演化

Microevolution is a small change in allele frequencies within one population. Macroevolution is big change over long time, including new species and new groups.微观演化是一个种群内等位基因频率的小变化；宏观演化是长时间的大变化，包括新物种和新类群。

Evolution · 5/10

How new species form新物种如何形成

A barrier, such as a river, splits a population. Each part collects different changes. In time they cannot interbreed. Then they are two species.河流等屏障把种群分开；各部分积累不同变化；时间久了无法相互繁殖，就成了两个物种。

Evolution · 6/10

Drift, bottleneck, founder漂变、瓶颈与奠基者

Chance can change allele frequencies, especially in small populations. A bottleneck shrinks the population; a founder group starts a new one with a small sample of alleles.偶然因素会改变等位基因频率，尤其在小种群中。瓶颈使种群缩小；奠基者带着一小部分等位基因建立新种群。

Evolution · 7/10

Convergent or divergent?趋同还是趋异？

Divergent: relatives become different. Convergent: non-relatives become similar because of similar environments.趋异：亲缘近的变得不同。趋同：亲缘远的因环境相似而变得相似。

Evolution · 8/10

Homologous or analogous?同源还是同功？

Homologous structures share an ancestor but may do different jobs. Analogous structures do the same job but come from different ancestors.同源结构有共同祖先，但功能可不同；同功结构功能相同，却来自不同的祖先。

Evolution · 9/10

Four lines of evidence四条证据

Fossils show change through time. Homologous structures show shared ancestry. Embryos of vertebrates look alike. DNA similarities match the family tree.化石显示随时间的变化；同源结构显示共同祖先；脊椎动物的胚胎相似；DNA 的相似度与亲缘树一致。

Evolution · 10/10

Artificial selection人工选择

People breed the organisms with the traits they want. Wild cabbage became broccoli, cabbage and kale this way.人们让具有想要性状的个体繁殖。野芥菜就是这样变成了西兰花、卷心菜和羽衣甘蓝。

cards.f: ev·o·LU·tion
cards.b:
Change in the inherited traits of a population over many generations.

演化：一个种群的遗传性状经过许多代而发生的改变。

🧠 e-volve = "unroll": the story of life unrolls over time.evolve = 展开：生命的故事随时间展开。

Quick check: Does one individual evolve, or does a population?

A population. Individuals do not evolve.

cards.f: TRAIT
cards.b:
A characteristic of an organism, such as fur colour or beak size.

性状：生物的某个特征，如毛色或喙的大小。

🧠 trait = Latin tractus, a drawn line or stroke: one feature of how you are drawn.trait 来自拉丁语 tractus（一笔、一道线）：你身上的一个特征。

Quick check: Give one example of a trait.

Eye colour, height, beak shape, leaf size, and so on.

cards.f: var·i·A·tion
cards.b:
The differences in traits among individuals of the same species.

变异：同一物种个体之间性状的差别。

🧠 vary = to differ. Without variation, natural selection has nothing to choose from.没有变异，自然选择就没东西可选。

Quick check: Why is variation needed for natural selection?

Selection can only favour traits that already differ among individuals.

cards.f: mu·TA·tion
cards.b:
A change in the DNA sequence. It is the original source of new alleles.

突变：DNA 序列发生的改变，是新等位基因的最初来源。

🧠 mutate = to change. Typo in the DNA.mutate = 改变：DNA 里的「错别字」。

Quick check: What is the original source of new alleles?

Mutation.

cards.f: HER·it·a·ble TRAIT
cards.b:
A trait that parents pass to offspring through their genes.

可遗传性状：亲代通过基因传给后代的性状。

🧠 heir = inheritor. A heritable trait can be inherited.heritable = 可被继承的。

Quick check: Can a scar from an injury be passed on to offspring?

No. It is not caused by genes, so it is not heritable.

cards.f: al·LELE
cards.b:
One version of a gene.

等位基因：同一个基因的不同版本。

🧠 allele ~ "other form". Gene = recipe, allele = one version of the recipe.基因 = 菜谱，等位基因 = 这份菜谱的不同版本。

Quick check: What do we call different versions of the same gene?

Alleles.

cards.f: GENE POOL
cards.b:
All the alleles found in all the members of a population.

基因库：一个种群全部个体所携带的全部等位基因。

🧠 Pool = everything swimming in one place.pool = 汇聚在一起的全部东西。

Quick check: What does the gene pool of a population contain?

All of its alleles.

cards.f: al·LELE FRE·quen·cy
cards.b:
How common an allele is in a population, as a percentage.

等位基因频率：某个等位基因在种群中所占的比例。

🧠 Frequency = how often. Evolution at its smallest = frequency changes.频率 = 出现得多频繁；演化最小的表现就是频率变化。

Quick check: If allele A is found in 30 of 100 copies, what is its frequency?

30%.

cards.f: NAT·u·ral se·LEC·tion
cards.b:
Individuals with traits that suit their environment survive and reproduce more, so those traits become more common.

自然选择：性状更适应环境的个体存活和繁殖得更多，这些性状在种群中越来越常见。

🧠 Nature does the selecting. Four steps: variation, inheritance, overproduction, differential survival.大自然来「选」：变异、遗传、过量繁殖、存活差异。

Quick check: Does natural selection change individuals or populations?

Populations. It changes which traits are common.

cards.f: FIT·ness
cards.b:
How well an organism survives and reproduces compared with others of its kind.

适合度：生物与同类相比，存活并繁殖后代的成功程度。

🧠 In biology "fit" means "leaves more offspring", not "strong".生物学里 fit = 留下更多后代，不是「强壮」。

Quick check: Is the strongest animal always the fittest?

No. Fitness is about leaving offspring.

cards.f: ad·ap·TA·tion
cards.b:
An inherited trait that helps an organism survive and reproduce in its environment.

适应：帮助生物在其环境中生存和繁殖的遗传性状。

🧠 adapt = fit to. An adaptation fits a body to its home.adapt = 使适合：让身体适合其环境。

Quick check: Is a giraffe stretching its neck an adaptation?

No. An adaptation is an inherited trait, not a behaviour done in one lifetime.

cards.f: se·LEC·tive PRES·sure
cards.b:
An environmental factor that affects which individuals survive and reproduce.

选择压力：影响哪些个体能存活并繁殖的环境因素。

🧠 pressure pushes the population in one direction.pressure = 把种群推向某个方向。

Quick check: Name one selective pressure.

Predators, disease, food shortage, climate change, and so on.

cards.f: com·pe·TI·tion
cards.b:
When organisms use the same limited resource, such as food, water or space.

竞争：生物争夺同一种有限资源，如食物、水或空间。

🧠 com- = together, petere = seek. Seek the same thing.com- = 一起，petere = 追求：追求同一样东西。

Quick check: Why does competition lead to selection?

Not everyone gets enough, so the better-suited individuals survive and reproduce more.

cards.f: mi·cro·ev·o·LU·tion
cards.b:
Small changes in allele frequencies within one population over a few generations.

微观演化：种群内等位基因频率在几代之间发生的小变化。

🧠 micro = small.micro = 小。

Quick check: Is a change in allele frequencies in one population micro- or macroevolution?

Microevolution.

cards.f: mac·ro·ev·o·LU·tion
cards.b:
Large changes over long time, such as the origin of new species and major groups.

宏观演化：经历很长时间的大变化，如新物种和大类群的起源。

🧠 macro = large.macro = 大。

Quick check: Is the origin of a new species micro- or macroevolution?

Macroevolution.

cards.f: spe·ci·A·tion
cards.b:
The formation of a new species from an existing one.

物种形成：从已有物种中形成新物种的过程。

🧠 species + -ation = making species.species + -ation = 形成物种。

Quick check: What is speciation?

One species splitting into two or more new species.

cards.f: re·pro·DUC·tive i·so·LA·tion
cards.b:
A barrier that stops two groups from mating or from producing fertile offspring.

生殖隔离：使两个群体无法交配、或无法产生可育后代的屏障。

🧠 isolate comes from Latin insula = island: cut off like an island.isolate 来自拉丁语 insula（岛）：像孤岛一样被隔开。

Quick check: What does reproductive isolation prevent?

Gene flow between groups, because they cannot interbreed successfully.

cards.f: ge·o·GRAPH·ic i·so·LA·tion
cards.b:
A physical barrier, such as a river or mountain range, that separates populations.

地理隔离：河流、山脉等自然屏障把种群分隔开。

🧠 geo = earth, graph = write/map. Separated on the map.geo = 地，graph = 图：在地图上被分开。

Quick check: Name an example of geographic isolation.

A new river, a mountain range or a stretch of ocean separating populations.

cards.f: a·DAP·tive ra·di·A·tion
cards.b:
Fast formation of many new species from one ancestor, each filling a different niche.

适应辐射：从一个祖先在较短时间内分化出许多新物种，各占不同生态位。

🧠 radiation = rays spreading out from a centre (like the sun).radiation = 像阳光一样从中心向外散开。

Quick check: Which famous example of adaptive radiation lives on the Galapagos?

Darwin's finches.

cards.f: con·VER·gent ev·o·LU·tion
cards.b:
Unrelated groups evolve similar traits because they face similar environments.

趋同演化：亲缘关系远的类群因环境相似而演化出相似的特征。

🧠 con- = together, verge = turn toward. Different roads, same place.convergent = 汇聚：不同路径，相同结果。

Quick check: Sharks and dolphins look alike but are not close relatives. What process explains this?

Convergent evolution.

cards.f: di·VER·gent ev·o·LU·tion
cards.b:
Related groups become more different over time as they adapt to different conditions.

趋异演化：亲缘相近的类群因适应不同条件而变得越来越不同。

🧠 di- = apart. Same ancestor, different paths.di- = 分开：同一祖先，不同路径。

Quick check: Do the arm of a human and the wing of a bat show divergent or convergent evolution?

Divergent. They came from a common ancestor.

cards.f: co·ev·o·LU·tion
cards.b:
Two species evolve in response to each other, over many generations.

协同演化：两个物种在长期相互作用中彼此推动着演化。

🧠 co- = together. Evolve together.co- = 共同。

Quick check: Give an example of coevolution.

Flowers and their pollinators, or predators and prey.

cards.f: ex·TINC·tion
cards.b:
The complete disappearance of a species.

灭绝：一个物种彻底消失。

🧠 ex- = out. Put out like a flame.ex- = 出：像火焰熄灭。

Quick check: What is extinction?

The complete disappearance of a species.

cards.f: MASS ex·TINC·tion
cards.b:
A short period in Earth history when a large share of all species die out.

大灭绝：地球历史上很短的一段时间里，大量物种同时消失。

🧠 Mass = a very large number at once. The dinosaurs went in one.mass = 大批量，一次性。

Quick check: Name a mass extinction.

The end-Cretaceous extinction about 66 million years ago, which ended the non-bird dinosaurs.

cards.f: ar·ti·FI·cial se·LEC·tion
cards.b:
People choose which organisms breed, to make traits they want more common.

人工选择：人类挑选哪些个体繁殖，使想要的性状越来越常见。

🧠 artificial = made by people. Humans do the selecting.artificial = 人造的：由人来选。

Quick check: How is artificial selection different from natural selection?

People, not the environment, choose which individuals breed.

cards.f: ge·NET·ic mod·i·fi·CA·tion
cards.b:
Changing an organism's DNA directly, for example by adding a gene from another species.

基因修饰（转基因）：直接改变生物的 DNA，例如加入另一物种的基因。

🧠 modify = change. Genetic modification = change the genes on purpose.modify = 改变；基因改造 = 有目的地改基因。

Quick check: How is genetic modification different from selective breeding?

It changes DNA directly instead of choosing who breeds.

cards.f: ge·NET·ic DRIFT
cards.b:
Random change in allele frequencies from one generation to the next, strongest in small populations.

遗传漂变：等位基因频率在代际之间的随机变化，在小种群中最明显。

🧠 Drift = a boat carried by chance, not steered.drift = 随波漂流：靠运气，不是靠适应。

Quick check: Is genetic drift caused by fitness?

No. It is random chance.

cards.f: GENE FLOW
cards.b:
The movement of alleles from one population to another when individuals migrate and breed.

基因流：个体迁移并繁殖后，等位基因在种群之间的转移。

🧠 flow = move. Alleles flow like water between populations.基因像水一样在种群间流动。

Quick check: What effect does gene flow have on two populations?

It makes them more alike.

cards.f: BOT·tle·neck ef·FECT
cards.b:
A sharp fall in population size that leaves a smaller, less varied gene pool.

瓶颈效应：种群数量骤减，使基因库变小、变异减少。

🧠 A bottle's narrow neck lets only a few through.瓶颈窄，只有少数能通过。

Quick check: What happens to genetic variation after a bottleneck?

It is reduced.

cards.f: FOUND·er ef·FECT
cards.b:
A new population started by a few individuals has only a small sample of the original alleles.

奠基者效应：少数个体建立的新种群，只带有原种群等位基因的一小部分。

🧠 founder = the person who starts something.founder = 创始者。

Quick check: A few birds blown to an island start a new population. Which effect is this?

The founder effect.

cards.f: FOS·sil
cards.b:
The preserved remains or traces of an organism that lived long ago.

化石：很久以前生活过的生物的遗体或遗迹被保存下来。

🧠 fossil comes from Latin fossilis = dug up.fossil 来自拉丁语：被挖出来的东西。

Quick check: What is a fossil?

The preserved remains or traces of an ancient organism.

cards.f: tran·SI·tion·al FOS·sil
cards.b:
A fossil that shows traits of both an older group and the group that came after it.

过渡化石：同时具有较早类群和后来类群特征的化石。

🧠 transition = going across. A bridge fossil.transition = 过渡：连接两端的「桥」。

Quick check: Name a transitional fossil.

Tiktaalik (fish to tetrapod) or Archaeopteryx (dinosaur to bird).

cards.f: ho·MOL·o·gous STRUC·ture
cards.b:
A body part that is alike in different species because they share a common ancestor.

同源结构：不同物种中因有共同祖先而相似的身体部分。

🧠 homo = same, logos = relation. Same origin.homo = 相同；同一来源。

Quick check: A human arm and a bat wing have the same bones. What kind of structure is this?

Homologous.

cards.f: a·NAL·o·gous STRUC·ture
cards.b:
A body part with a similar job in different species that did not come from a common ancestor part.

同功结构：不同物种中功能相似、但并非来自共同祖先同一结构的身体部分。

🧠 ana- = according to. Analogy = similar job.analogy = 功能相似的类比。

Quick check: Do a bird wing and an insect wing show homology or analogy?

Analogy. They fly, but do not share a common ancestor structure.

cards.f: ves·TIG·i·al STRUC·ture
cards.b:
A reduced body part that has little or no use now but had a use in ancestors.

退化结构：如今作用很小或没有作用、但祖先中有功能的退化器官。

🧠 vestigium = footprint, a trace left behind.vestigium = 足迹：留下的痕迹。

Quick check: Whales have tiny hip bones. What do we call them?

Vestigial structures.

cards.f: com·PAR·a·tive em·bry·OL·o·gy
cards.b:
Comparing the early development of different species, which looks very alike in related groups.

比较胚胎学：比较不同物种的早期胚胎发育；亲缘相近的类群胚胎很相似。

🧠 embryo = the earliest stage of development.embryo = 最早期的发育阶段。

Quick check: What does embryology show about vertebrates?

Their early embryos look very similar, which points to a common ancestor.

cards.f: mo·LEC·u·lar EV·i·dence
cards.b:
Similarities in DNA or proteins between species, showing how closely related they are.

分子证据：不同物种 DNA 或蛋白质的相似程度，反映亲缘关系远近。

🧠 molecule = a tiny unit of matter; DNA is a molecule that keeps the record.DNA 是记录亲缘的分子。

Quick check: Which species shares more DNA with humans: a chimpanzee or a mouse?

The chimpanzee.

cards.f: an·ti·bi·OT·ic re·SIS·tance
cards.b:
The ability of bacteria to survive an antibiotic, which spreads by natural selection.

抗生素耐药性：细菌抵抗抗生素而存活的能力，会通过自然选择扩散。

🧠 anti = against, bio = life. Resistance = a refusal to be killed.anti = 对抗；bio = 生命；resistance = 抵抗。

Quick check: Why does using antibiotics too often cause resistance?

It kills the non-resistant bacteria, so the resistant ones survive and multiply.

cards.f: SEX·u·al se·LEC·tion
cards.b:
Selection for traits that help an organism win a mate, such as a peacock's tail.

性选择：对有助于获得配偶的性状的选择，如孔雀的尾羽。

🧠 sex = about mates.sexual = 与配偶有关。

Quick check: What does sexual selection favour?

Traits that help an individual get mates.

quiz.q: Which statement about evolution is correct?
opts: An individual changes its genes to fit its environment
quiz.why: Evolution is change in the inherited traits of a population over time.

quiz.q: Which is the original source of new alleles?
quiz.why: Mutations create new alleles. Selection only sorts them.

quiz.q: In natural selection, "fitness" means
quiz.why: Fitness is about leaving offspring, not strength.

quiz.q: Which is an example of an adaptation?
opts: Thick fur passed from parents in cold climates
quiz.why: Adaptations are inherited traits that help survival.

quiz.q: Natural selection acts directly on
quiz.why: It favours individuals with helpful traits, but the population changes as a result.

quiz.q: Microevolution is best described as
opts: the origin of a new phylum
a change in allele frequencies in a population
quiz.why: Small-scale change in allele frequencies.

quiz.why: A physical barrier separates the groups.

quiz.q: Sharks and dolphins have similar body shapes but are not closely related. This is
quiz.why: Similar environments produced similar traits in unrelated groups.

quiz.q: A human arm and a whale flipper have the same bones. These are

quiz.q: A bird wing and an insect wing are
quiz.why: Same function, different origin.

quiz.why: A sharp drop in population size.

quiz.q: Which is artificial selection?
opts: Farmers breed cows that give the most milk
quiz.why: People choose which individuals breed.

quiz.q: Antibiotic-resistant bacteria become common because
opts: resistant bacteria survive and reproduce when antibiotics are used
quiz.why: Selection favours the bacteria already resistant.

quiz.q: A fossil with features of both fish and four-legged animals is a
quiz.why: It shows a link between two groups.

quiz.q: Which evidence compares DNA between species?
quiz.why: DNA and protein similarities show relatedness.

quiz.q:

Which term matches this definition?

quiz.why: genetic modification: Changing an organism's DNA directly, for example by adding a gene from another species. 基因修饰（转基因）

quiz.q:
Which term matches this definition?
“Random change in allele frequencies from one generation to the next, strongest in small populations.”
quiz.why: genetic drift: Random change in allele frequencies from one generation to the next, strongest in small populations. 遗传漂变

quiz.q:
Which term matches this definition?
“A change in the DNA sequence. It is the original source of new alleles.”
quiz.why: mutation: A change in the DNA sequence. It is the original source of new alleles. 突变

quiz.q:
Which term matches this definition?
“Related groups become more different over time as they adapt to different conditions.”
quiz.why: divergent evolution: Related groups become more different over time as they adapt to different conditions. 趋异演化

quiz.q:
Which term matches this definition?
“The differences in traits among individuals of the same species.”
quiz.why: variation: The differences in traits among individuals of the same species. 变异

quiz.q:
Which term matches this definition?
“When organisms use the same limited resource, such as food, water or space.”
quiz.why: competition: When organisms use the same limited resource, such as food, water or space. 竞争

Which term matches this definition?
“A body part that is alike in different species because they share a common ancestor.”
